title: Cascade Challenge
description: Write conflicting CSS rules and predict which style wins based on specificity and order.
hints: The ID selector has higher specificity than class or type selectors.
To override without !important, you need higher specificity or same specificity but later in source order.
Inheritance means child elements inherit the body's colour unless explicitly overridden.
expectedOutput: A single CSS block (or multiple comments) with correct predictions and the demonstrated inheritance example.
